messages.subject: undocumented function.
parts:
Before I forget, the manual needs to document trunc_normal_log. Of all
the functions that are in the function_headers.hpp, that's the only
one that was left out in the doc. Bob, awesome job documenting
everything. I don't know how you kept everything together.

I haven't checked the other direction, that is functions that we can
use, but aren't documented and aren't in function_headers.hpp.


I just tested each of the functions directly in the transformed {data,
parameters} blocks. I guess I should also test the distributions in
the model block. Do you think that's overkill? By test, I mean that
stanc can parse it and the generated cpp code is compilable by a c++
compiler.



Daniel
